description: A four channel stereo performance mixer with pan, mute, two aux sends and two aux returns on every channel

params.text: Sets the level of both mix outputs
Sets how much of the A return is added to the mix
Sets how much of the B return is added to the mix
Sets the level of both A send outputs
Sets the level of both B send outputs
Sets the level of that channel
Places that channel across the stereo field, hard left anticlockwise and hard right clockwise
Sets how much of that channel goes to the A send
Sets how much of that channel goes to the B send
Silences that channel, one press off and the next on

inputs.text: The left input of that channel, spread across the mix by the pan knob while the right input of that channel is empty
The right input of that channel; patching it stops the panning and carries left and right straight through
Scales that channel, 10V leaving it at the fader setting and 0V silencing it
A rising edge silences that channel, and the next one lets it through again
Moves that channel across the stereo field, added to the pan knob, hard left at -5V and hard right at 5V
Scales that channel's A send, 10V leaving it at the knob setting and 0V removing it
Scales that channel's B send, 10V leaving it at the knob setting and 0V removing it
The left side of the A return, added to the left mix at the A return level
The right side of the A return, added to the right mix at the A return level
The left side of the B return, added to the left mix at the B return level
The right side of the B return, added to the right mix at the B return level

outputs.text: The left side of the mix
The right side of the mix
The left side of the A send, the four channels mixed at their A send settings
The right side of the A send, the four channels mixed at their A send settings
The left side of the B send, the four channels mixed at their B send settings
The right side of the B send, the four channels mixed at their B send settings
